quest.title: An Honest Promotion
quest.description: "Buy one get one free! My loss if you buy, your loss if you don't!"\nBut what sort of gullible folk would be taken in by such slogans... Wait, Paimon pre-ordered already?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Paimon can see that the commissions have been pretty taxing lately.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As a thoughtful, capable guide, Paimon's duty is to help you relax, so... Ta-da! Guess where this is?

choices.text: Well, it says "Damoville Purveyor" on the sign right here.

response.speaker: Boucicaut
response.text: Hello there. Welcome to Damoville Purveyor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This is no ordinary store. This is a place where hardworking laborers relax via spending money.

response.speaker: Boucicaut
response.text: Indeed, indeed! In fact, we have recently launched a buy one get one free promotion, with all customers welcome to take part!

response.speaker: Boucicaut
response.text: My loss if you buy, your loss if you don't!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon saw the event poster when we passed by before. That's how she remembered it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Double the goods for every purchase sounds like a great deal, no matter how you slice it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It always feels like there's something missing in Paimon's day if she doesn't spend some Mora here... So today, we're coming here together to fill that gap!

choices.text: And what would you like to buy, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, not telling you just yet.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Payment might get tricky that way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nah, don't worry. Paimon brought her own Mora today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Boss, has the order arrived yet? It's under "Paimon and {NICKNAME}."

response.speaker: Boucicaut
response.text: We do have your package. One moment...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Boucicaut the shopkeeper retrieves something over-packaged beyond identification. Beside you, Paimon fishes out a large pile of pocket money. You detect a hint of sadness on her face as she parts with this sizable sum.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After you unwrap the package together, you realize that it contains two photo albums.

choices.text: And how shall this yawning void be filled, Paimon?
Ah, the abode of Mora thieves, the graveyard of wallets.

response.speaker: Boucicaut
response.text: Dear me, dear customer, do not speak such inaccuracies. Damoville Purveyor is committed wholly to affordability and quality. You may survey our prices should you wish.
